theme: 旅行住宿：协商换房与确认费用
title: A Quieter Room Without a Bigger Bill
subtitle: 3段故事与对话，每段约50–65词；5个词组，1个语法点。两天分段背诵，约10分钟含朗读与练习。

items.example: Her room overlooks a busy street.
She explains the problem without losing her temper.
The hotel offers another room at no extra charge.

sections.label: Reading
sections.title: 英语短文 · 两天背诵版
sections.heading: A Practical Request at Reception
paragraphs: After a long train journey, Lena arrives at her hotel, hoping for a quiet evening. However, her room overlooks a busy street, and the traffic keeps her awake. As a light sleeper, she knows that another restless night will spoil her plans. Rather than lose her temper, she decides to explain the problem calmly at reception.

“I realise the hotel is nearly full, but would it be possible to move to a quieter room?” she asks. The receptionist offers a larger room for an additional fee. “Thank you, but that would exceed my budget,” Lena replies. “I don’t need more space. I’d be happy with a smaller room, provided it is away from the street.”

After checking availability, the receptionist finds a room facing the courtyard and offers it at no extra charge. Before accepting, Lena asks whether breakfast is still included and requests written confirmation of the arrangement. Ten minutes later, she settles into her new room, relieved that a clear request and a little flexibility have led to a practical solution.

items.explanation: 表示“只要……／条件是……”，引导条件状语从句，that 可以省略。比 if 更强调接受某个安排的前提。
items.example: I’d be happy with a smaller room, provided it is away from the street.

items.question: 用 provided (that) 表达：只要包含早餐，我就愿意接受这个房间。
第1天：背第1段和第2段前半部分。第2天：背剩余内容并全文复述。用“发现问题 → 礼貌协商 → 确认解决”串起三段。
